missing_evidence: Redis server latency/error metrics for reserve_inventory during incident window
candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (DependencyUnavailable), causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503 and order /v1/orders to fail with ReadTimeout, which surfaces as 502 on gateway /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics or logs; timeout cause (saturation vs network) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts propagating through inventory and order to gateway 502s on /v1/checkout; logs and metrics corroborate ~2s checkout latency and 502s. Bounded to redis-timeout; redis-side telemetry absent.
